mapper.select: SELECT u.*, c.class_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN class c ON u.class_id = c.id WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT u.*, c.class_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN class c ON u.class_id = c.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT u.*, c.class_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN class c ON u.class_id = c.id ORDER BY u.id DESC
SELECT u.*, c.class_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN class c ON u.class_id = c.id WHERE u.role = #{role} ORDER BY u.id DESC
SELECT u.*, c.class_name FROM user u LEFT JOIN class c ON u.class_id = c.id WHERE u.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY u.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, name, role, class_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{classId})
